name: io.github.thedatasense/anatid
title: anatid memory
description: Local memory for AI agents, with evidence, corrections and history. One DuckDB file. Bitemporal graph memory with provenance, hybrid recall and approval-gated writes.

packageArguments.name: --db
packageArguments.description: Path of the anatid database file to open. Created if absent. Use --socket instead to share one memory through a running anatid-server.

environmentVariables.name: ANATID_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the anatid database file (alternative to --db).

environmentVariables.name: ANATID_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Tenant id the server is pinned to. Defaults to 1.

environmentVariables.name: ANATID_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Unix socket of a running anatid-server. When set, the MCP server writes through it so several clients can share one memory.
